2025-10-27.riddle: I stretch across the sky but break with rain; I paint in colors but hold no brush. What am I?
2025-10-27.hint: I appear when sunlight meets rain.

2025-10-28.riddle: I wait in darkness till struck by light, then burst to life in sparks of white. What am I?

2025-10-29.riddle: I open wide to let you in but close to keep you safe within. What am I?
2025-10-29.hint: I separate one space from another.

2025-10-30.riddle: I wander the night in a glowing disguise; carved with a smile, I light up the skies. What am I?
2025-10-30.hint: I’m a pumpkin with a candle inside.

2025-10-31.riddle: I come out at night but vanish at dawn; children chase me door to door. What am I?
2025-10-31.hint: I collect sweets once a year.

2025-11-01.riddle: I fall but never get hurt; I change the trees with every turn. What am I?
2025-11-01.hint: I drift down in autumn’s breeze.

2025-11-02.riddle: I fly without wings, I fall without fear, I drift and disappear. What am I?
2025-11-02.hint: Each one of me is unique.

2025-11-03.riddle: I sleep underground through frost and cold, but come springtime, I wake in gold. What am I?
2025-11-03.hint: I grow when the earth warms.

2025-11-04.riddle: I run through cities yet have no legs; I bring people but never walk. What am I?

2025-11-05.riddle: I can fill a room without taking space, brighten a face, and fade without a trace. What am I?

2025-11-06.riddle: I’m taken in at night, lost in sleep, and found again at dawn. What am I?

2025-11-07.riddle: I hold memories but never think; I can replay your laughter or your tears. What am I?

2025-11-08.riddle: I grow when I’m fed but die when I drink. What am I?

2025-11-09.riddle: I’m not alive, yet I can move mountains; I can shatter steel but flow like silk. What am I?
2025-11-09.hint: I shape the earth with patience.

2025-11-10.riddle: I’m drawn but never written, erased but never forgotten. What am I?
2025-11-10.hint: You see me only on cold mornings.

2025-11-11.riddle: I’m carried everywhere but never move; I hold lives and secrets in my circuits. What am I?
2025-11-11.hint: I connect you across the world.

2025-11-12.riddle: I hide your thoughts behind my lines, I guard your work with spine and bind. What am I?
2025-11-12.hint: I store your handwriting and ideas.

2025-11-13.riddle: I light up the sky yet I’m not the sun; I roar with power when storms have begun. What am I?

2025-11-14.riddle: I build but never rest, one grain at a time. I move with the wind, shaping deserts divine. What am I?

2025-11-15.riddle: I rise when it’s cold and melt when it’s warm. I sparkle but fear the sun. What am I?
2025-11-15.hint: I turn to water in heat.

2025-11-16.riddle: I have feathers but don’t fly, I wake you each dawn with my cry. What am I?
2025-11-16.hint: I crow to greet the morning.

2025-11-17.riddle: I hide treasures in my shell, I crawl but never rush. I carry my home wherever I go. What am I?
2025-11-17.hint: My house is always on my back.

2025-11-18.riddle: I ring to signal danger or time, I hang above yet never climb. What am I?
2025-11-18.hint: You hear me at schools and towers.

2025-11-19.riddle: I stretch from shore to shore but never rest; I’m endless and blue, yet full of guests. What am I?
2025-11-19.hint: I cover most of Earth’s surface.

2025-11-20.riddle: I’m small and round, full of warmth and sound; I guide travelers with my light. What am I?
2025-11-20.hint: I glow in your hand at night.

2025-11-21.riddle: I have pages but no words, worlds but no people, and players who explore my depths. What am I?
2025-11-21.hint: I hold stories that you control.

2025-11-22.riddle: I rise with heat, fall with cold, and vanish when touched. What am I?

2025-11-23.riddle: I’m cracked on purpose, filled with joy, and eaten warm or cold. What am I?

2025-11-24.riddle: I gather families once a year, fill tables with warmth, and end in thanks. What am I?

2025-11-25.riddle: I’m soft yet strong, I cover you at night, and fold neatly by morning light. What am I?
2025-11-25.hint: I keep you warm when you sleep.

2025-11-26.riddle: I’m rolled and twisted, baked and browned, covered in butter or cream. What am I?

2025-11-27.riddle: I appear after dinner, sweet and round; I come in pies or by the pound. What am I?
2025-11-27.hint: I’m the final course of the meal.

2025-11-28.riddle: I flash and shine but never burn; I decorate nights where people turn. What am I?

2025-11-29.riddle: I come once a year bringing cheer; I dress trees and windows clear. What am I?

2025-11-30.riddle: I end one chapter and start the next; I close with reflection and open with hope. What am I?
2025-11-30.hint: I pass before time begins anew.
